Job Description:
At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day. Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits. We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths - whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve. Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role-specific responsibilities and business needs. At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
Job Description:
This job is responsible for providing standard research, reporting and analytical support for the delivery of regulatory reporting. Key responsibilities include end-to-end reporting support for cross border payments, electronic transactions, sales, trading and underwriting business for securities, foreign exchange, fixed income, exchange traded derivatives and over-the-counter derivatives across multiple lines of business. Job expectations include following the established procedures under general supervision and oversight, and assisting less experienced teammates.
An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Global Markets Regulatory Reporting Analyst to join our APAC Governed Reporting and Data (GRD) Global Markets NFRR Reporting team. Our team plays an important role in supporting the bank's regulatory reporting obligations across Global Markets products and key APAC jurisdictions, including China and Japan.
This role provides an opportunity to build expertise across Global Markets, regulatory reporting, data and operations, while working with a broad range of partners including Front Office, Operations, Compliance, Data and Technology. You will support the day-to-day delivery of regulatory reporting while also helping the team respond to new regulatory requirements, reporting changes and opportunities to improve and scale our processes.
We are looking for someone who is curious, analytical and comfortable taking ownership, someone who can connect the dots, solve problems and navigate across different teams to get to the right outcome.
Key responsibilities
Support the accurate, complete and timely delivery of Global Markets regulatory reporting across applicable markets and regulators.
Investigate and resolve reporting exceptions, data issues and operational challenges, working across teams to identify root causes and solutions.
Build strong partnerships across Front Office, Global Markets Operations, Compliance, Data and Technology.
Take ownership of assigned deliverables and initiatives, driving them from problem identification through to resolution.
Support new and changing regulatory reporting requirements, including onboarding and changes to existing reporting processes.
Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize and improve reporting processes and controls.
Apply a strong risk and control mindset to the delivery of regulatory reporting.
Contribute to projects and change initiatives that strengthen the scalability and sustainability of the reporting environment.
Responsibilities:
Delivers standard regulatory reports to regulatory agencies in line with expectations on completeness, accuracy, and timeliness
Executes control practices, including compliance with all regulatory and policy requirements, including data quality standards

Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities and take ownership of deliverables.
Strong stakeholder-management skills and confidence working across different teams and functions.

Job Type
Full Time
Job Reference #
346246BR
City
Shanghai
Key Responsibilities
We are looking for someone who can
Participate in the pricing and risk analysis of various portfolios. The analysis reports are basis for making trading or hedging decisions on the portfolio.
Develop light spreadsheet tools to help traders analyze and monitor their trading exposures.
Develop marking tools using market information using Python.
Develop library for the bank pricing and booking systems.
Develop, generate and validate regular analytic reports for the trading desks.
Documentation of theory and implementation (Latex)
Provide test and control framework for front to back operational testing / recoverability
Participate in technology design discussions for scalability and performance
Provide support/tools for explaining P&L, Risk and OTC products pricing.
The team
The Shanghai Quantitative Analytics Group of UBS is an entrepreneurial, cross-asset team focusing on building the market-leading analytics across all asset classes and provides comprehensive quantitative analysis support to all business units throughout the Investment Bank in all regions. In collaboration with trading, the team also takes advantage of the fast growing FinTech trend. It was established in 2006 and located in Lu Jia Zui Financial Town of Shanghai Pudong. It has a stable team of quantitative analysts and developers with a diverse academic background (e.g. Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, Physics and Financial Engineering).
Your Skills And Experience
Graduate between Sep 2027 and Jul 2028. Minimum bachelor's degree from a top tier university, preferably in Science or Finance disciplines (e.g. Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Quantitative Economics or Financial Engineering).
Strong analytical abilities and sound logic is required.
Familiar with Python, or other object oriented computer languages: C++ , C#, Java. Proficiency in Excel VBA is a plus.
Mastering a statistical program language such as R statistic package is a plus
SQL databases, KDB and Linux is a plus
Good sense with numbers, fast-learning and detail oriented.
Fluent in both written and spoken English. Minimum CET 6 or equivalent.
Good team spirits with excellent communication skills.
About Us
UBS is a leading and truly global wealth manager and the leading universal bank in Switzerland. We also provide diversified asset management solutions and focused investment banking capabilities. Headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland, UBS is present in more than 50 markets around the globe.
We know that great work is never done alone. That’s why we place collaboration at the heart of everything we do. Because together, we’re more than ourselves. Want to find out more? Visit ubs.com/careers.
Join us
At UBS, we know that it's our people, with their diverse skills, experiences and backgrounds, who drive our ongoing success. We’re dedicated to our craft and passionate about putting our people first, with new challenges, a supportive team, opportunities to grow and flexible working options when possible. Our inclusive culture brings out the best in our employees, wherever they are on their career journey. And we use artificial intelligence (AI) to work smarter and more efficiently. We also recognize that great work is never done alone. That’s why collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. Because together, we’re more than ourselves.
We’re committed to disability inclusion and if you need reasonable accommodation/adjustments throughout our recruitment process, you can always contact us.
